changelog: Concurrent sharded search: songs shard + broad shard fetched in parallel, merged and deduped.
Stale-while-revalidate caching: repeat searches served in 0ms while refreshing in background.
LRU cache cap (300 entries) fixes unbounded memory growth.
Payload slimming: track objects stripped to essential fields (~35% smaller app responses).
Home page sections served via SWR: 0ms repeat loads.

presentation.purpose: Primary music connector with smart search and taste learning
